task: ae.flow network-flow toolkit (Dinic, min-cost flow, Hopcroft-Karp, Hungarian) and text-spec shift planner
reasoning_summary: Designed FlowNetwork with paired residual arcs and iterative Dinic/SPFA so deep chains are safe, then Hopcroft-Karp with Konig cover, Hungarian, and a planner on min-cost max-flow. Tests were written first against independent oracles (Edmonds-Karp, brute-force flow enumeration, Kuhn, permutations, subset enumeration). All 40 tests passed on the first run; mutation checks on Konig, Hungarian potentials and planner ordering were all caught.
